output.summary: The backlog growth is mainly self-inflicted by the quota. First-contact demand rose only 4%, while splits, duplicates and reopens rose sharply. Agents game the metric (E4, E5), pick quick tickets (E6), and complex tickets age. The unquota'd Billing pod stayed stable (E7). Team C, which excluded reopened closes, cut reopens but still shows splitting. The reopen artifact theory is refuted (E14). Capacity was flat and Payroll is a minor share. Suspend the individual quota and move to quality measures, and classify aged complex tickets with Engineering. Do not tighten the quota or commit the irreversible $744k headcount yet. Quota-driven attrition and the Engineering contribution are not fully established.
